Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: nine interchangeable wearable attachment parts for the EXACT animal style in reference image 1 (friend-cat). Reference is style and anatomy only, NOT an edit target. Create one clean 3 by 3 sprite atlas on genuine alpha transparency, all nine objects complete, isolated and centered within generously padded equal cells; no text/grid/animal/head/fur/background. Follow original character art: SIMPLE warm brown ink outlines, flat pale watercolor fills, paper-like gentle texture, low-detail illustrated children's-book shapes. DO NOT use realistic fabric, realistic 3D shading or photorealistic plush texture.
Reading order exactly:
1 little green sprout with two leaves and tiny fitted curved stem,
2 warm golden five-tip crown with a central small star,
3 lavender low-profile beret with a shallow curved fitted brim,
4 coral cream-dot party cone hat with small golden pompom,
5 pink five-petal flower barrette with warm yellow center and small green leaf,
6 dusty rose bow tie: TWO wings and a central knot, front view, compact squat shape, NO large circular collar or rear oval band,
7 sage green knitted scarf: very shallow open curved neckline fitting below a round chin, one short hanging tassel end on viewer-right; no giant empty ring/hole,
8 blue ribbon neck medal with small gold star: shallow open V/U blue band with small star pendant at center, NO giant vertical empty oval,
9 denim-blue triangular bandana with shallow concave fitted upper edge and small front triangle, no large rear ring.
These are close-fitting physical wearable pieces, curved to the animal's rounded head/jaw. Different animals receive bespoke shape and art, maintain consistent item identity and palette. No free-floating collar loops, cut-off ends, stray fragments, tags or decorative sparkles. All items fully inside their own equal cells with 15% transparent cell margin.
